name: COSMOS (Elegoo Centauri Carbon)
description: OpenCentauri COSMOS PRINT_START (macros.cfg, 26.08). Klipper does not echo the macro's own commands, so the stream is sparse: the M190/M109 waits report only 'B:x /t T0:y /t' lines, which match nothing here and leave heating to the collector's temperature detection. The macro narrates through SET_DISPLAY_TEXT (heat soak, chamber wait, mesh choice) and the KAMP/skew macros through RESPOND. The skew check is the macro's last narrated step before the first layer, so it completes the pre-print. Weights follow a measured cold start at 105C bed / 260C nozzle: G28 ~23s, M190 ~484s, 60s heat soak, stored mesh load under 1s, M109 ~48s, line purge ~13s.

response_patterns.pattern: No skew profile defined|Skew profile '[^']*' found
